# Pasteberth

> Pasteberth is a self-hosted staging and exchange layer for files and clipboard artifacts, backed by ordinary filesystem directories and accessible through Web, filesystem, CLI and programmatic workflows.

Status: **Beta**. An artifact is not limited to text or screenshots: PDFs, spreadsheets, archives and other allowed files can also be staged and retrieved. Previewing or copying content to the clipboard depends on the content type. Participants may be one person returning later, people, agents, scripts or processes; graphical and terminal interfaces are not assigned to fixed roles.

A zone is a named directory. Managed items use a coherent data-file/JSON-sidecar pair; unrelated files remain foreign. `cp` followed by `register` validates an existing file and creates or refreshes the sidecar without rewriting the data or contacting the daemon. `drop` contacts the service, even when local staging avoids an HTTP payload transfer. The optional MCP adapter is a publication interface, not a claim of complete browsing and administration support.

Zone collections discover eligible directories through background scans. Project templates can provision exchange directories under a shared convention; discovery does not create them or bypass permissions. Groups are views, not ACLs. Pasteberth is not a public file host, cloud drive or cross-server synchronization service.

- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fade78/pasteberth/main/GUIDE.md): installation, configuration, CLI, zone collections and deployment guidance.
